quote: Mermaid is the diagram language unless the user names another.
When the user names D2, stop and use d2-architect instead.
Do not turn an ad hoc request into a document sweep.
Every heading (H1-H6) of the document gets at least one diagram
Write the caption in bold text.
keeps its exact label in the parent diagram
Put every flowchart node label and edge label in double quotes.
Never draw a diagram with ASCII or box-drawing characters
Convert an ASCII diagram in a document only when the user asks.
Each diagram renders inside 1200 by 1000 pixels
View each `diagram-N.png` one at a time, never several at once
